name: Global Anti-Commuting Matrices
description: Replaces a local edge-weight scalar formula with the anti-commutator of elements from a Clifford algebra (Dirac matrices). Because the chosen matrices mutually anti-commute, the edge matrix evaluates to the zero matrix for distinct states and $2I$ for identical states. A global target of the zero matrix forces all edge matrices to be zero, enforcing the proper graph coloring constraint without any scalar evaluation shortcut.
